messages:
sophie: Heads-up — nightly eval (faq_prompts) shows a jump in hallucination rate for rwd-13b-q8. Yesterday 0.6%, this morning 5.8%. attaching a couple of flagged outputs below.

maya: Yikes. Can you paste one of the failing generations?

sophie: sure — example from prompt id=faqq_0421:
```
Q: Who founded Redwood Inference?
A: Redwood Inference was founded in 2015 by Elon Musk and a group of engineers.
```
(ground truth: founded by ex-AI infra folks — not Elon)

linus: That looks like a clear hallucination. Any infra changes pushed overnight? quant/ tokenization/ tokenizer-model?

nightly-eval-bot: nightly-eval report: model=rwd-13b-q8, commit=7c3a9f2, dataset=faq_prompts, hallucination_rate=5.8%, last_run=1784551200

maya: commit 7c3a9f2 corresponds to the kernel+quant changes (PR #1482). Tokenizer wasn't supposed to change in that PR. But we did land a new tokenization indexing tweak in PR #1490 (diff small) at 1784549000 — could be related.

sophie: PR #1490 was the minimal detokenizer fix (handle U+200B). I didn't think that would surface here but could. Also note the quant pipeline reran and produced a new q8 artifact at 1784549800.

kai: Two orthogonal suspects: tokenizer edge-case handling, or quantization-induced softmax shift for proper names. Quick repro plan: run the faq_prompts through (a) rwd-13b-fp16@7c3a9f2 + tokenizer v3.1, (b) rwd-13b-q8@7c3a9f2 + tokenizer v3.1, (c) rwd-13b-q8@7c3a9f2 + tokenizer v3.2 (the new one). Compare hallucination deltas.

linus: I'll kick off targeted runs. command I use: 
```bash
./scripts/run_eval.sh --model rwd-13b-q8 --commit 7c3a9f2 --prompts data/faq_prompts.jsonl --out /tmp/q8_out.jsonl
```
I'll run variants and post diffs.

sophie: posted one more weird case where the model invents a date and location for a product launch. Also saw a tiny subset with repetition loops: 
```
...and the product was launched in 2019. The product was launched in 2019. The product was launched in 2019...
```

maya: repetition loops usually point to kernel/regression in kv-cache handling or attention masking. But small factual inserts point to tokenization/embedding changes. 

linus: first run (fp16 baseline) done: hallucination_rate=0.7% (tokenizer v3.1). q8 with tokenizer v3.1 => 1.2% (small uptick). q8 with tokenizer v3.2 => 5.6% (matches nightly). So the new tokenizer correlates strongly. full diffs: /tmp/eval_diffs_178455.txt

kai: Good catch. What exactly changed in v3.2?

maya: v3.2 changed how we normalize invisible unicode (U+200B) and also reindexed a few multi-byte sequences to collapse variants. That can shift token boundaries for proper nouns and dates. If the model learned priors tied to tokenization, output distribution could shift after re-tokenization.

sophie: So root cause likely tokenizer reindex + quant amplification. Next steps: roll tokenizer v3.1 back in nightly canary, and run a targeted small-batch eval on production traffic (non-sensitive) to confirm. Also revert PR #1490 in canary.

linus: I'll open a hotfix PR to pin tokenizer v3.1 for nightly and Dedicated canaries. PR draft: #1505.

nightly-eval-bot: action queued: revert_tokenizer_canary -> starts in 5m.

maya: Also let's add a unit test in eval harness that compares tokenization boundaries for the faq_prompts between tokenizer versions and flags >0.5% boundary drift. That would have caught this. I'll file a follow-up.

kai: For longer term: add a small calibration step after tokenizer or quant changes: run 1k prompt quick-check against stable truth set and block promotion if hallucination delta > 1%.

sophie: Agree. For now owners: linus = rollout hotfix (pin), maya = test + followup, kai = define calibration threshold. I'll monitor overnight. Thanks all :thumbsup:

linus: hotfix PR #1505 created and pinned to nightly job. rolling to canary now.

nightly-eval-bot: canary run complete: hallucination_rate=0.8% (matches baseline). Reverting tokenizer v3.2 in nightly succeeded.

sophie: closing the thread for tracking — will reopen if anything regresses. Great quick response team.
